hardness.label: Very Hard
hardness.intro: Katy water comes from Gulf Coast Aquifer groundwater and tests at a working 15 to 17 GPG. Click a community to see what that means for your home. [VERIFY: working figure]
hardness.reportNote: A working figure of 15 to 17 GPG (about 257 to 291 mg/L) puts Katy water above the 10.5 GPG Very Hard line on the Water Quality Association scale. The City of Katy's report does not state hardness, so confirm it with a tap test or your provider's report. [VERIFY: working figure]
hardness.footnote: Hardness is a working figure for Katy groundwater, not a reading at your tap. Many Katy addresses are served by a Municipal Utility District, so check your water bill for the provider; a free water test shows your own number. [VERIFY: confirm against the City of Katy or your MUD's report]
